title: How would you estimate how many piano tuners work in Chicago?
description: A step-by-step estimate for "How many piano tuners work in Chicago?" with the approach, the maths and a sanity check.
hook: The most famous sizing question of all, first popularised by the physicist Enrico Fermi. It is a chain of five reasonable guesses. Have a go at your own estimate before reading on.
body:
The question

How many piano tuners work in Chicago?

The approach

Pianos × tunings per year ÷ tunings one tuner can do per year.

Tip: If you are unsure of a number, say your assumption and why. A reasoned guess beats a confident invention.

Step by step

  1. People in Chicago: 2.7M
  2. ÷ 2.5 people per household
  3. × 5% households with a piano
  4. × 1 tuning per piano per year
  5. ÷ 1,000 tunings one tuner does per year (4 a day, 250 days)

That gives about 54 piano tuners.

Does it make sense?

Schools, churches and concert halls add some pianos, so the true number might be a little higher.
